title: DepotWatch CSV import preset
description: One provider's CSV export format, described completely enough for the import wizard to run on it without a single question. Configuration only: a preset never carries transactions, amounts, addresses or file names (see README.md).

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema, not of the provider's export format.

id.description: Stable, unique across all shipped presets. Kebab case, usually provider + format version.

provider.description: Exchange, broker or wallet the export comes from. Groups the picker.

formatVersion.description: Version of the provider's export format, so several presets of one provider can live side by side. Free text, compared numerically where it can be ("2" < "10", "2024.1" < "2024.2").

description.description: One or two sentences: which export this is, where it is found in the provider's UI, what it does not cover.

dateFormat.description: How the mapped date column reads.

timeFormat.description: How the mapped time column reads; "datetime" means the clock time is taken out of a full timestamp.

columnMapping.description: Target field → column header, exactly as the header row spells it. Unmapped fields are simply absent.

unitMapping.description: Which unit the amount and fee columns are written in.

valueMapping.description: What the type column's values mean. Keys are the values as the file writes them.

fixedType.description: Every row gets this type; for exports that hold one kind of row only (a withdrawal report, say). Mutually exclusive with a mapped type column.

feeInterpretation.description: Whether a fee is already inside the amount it belongs to — asked once per direction for BTC, once for fiat (CLAUDE.md §3.4).

btcIn.description: Buys: "deducted" = the BTC amount is what was really credited, "notDeducted" = the fee is still inside it.

btcOut.description: Sells, spends, outgoing transfers: same question.

fiat.description: "gross" = the EUR amount already contains the fee, "net" = the fee comes on top.

rowFilter.description: Which lines take part in the import at all. A rule naming a column the file does not have is ignored rather than dropping every row.

headerSignature.description: The header row of a real export from this provider, so the wizard can recognise the file. Compared case-insensitively, whitespace-collapsed, order-independent; extra columns in the file do not disqualify a match.

createdAt.description: When this preset was exported (ISO-8601). Documentation only — nothing reads it to decide anything.
